# Read-only by design (no Bash); jailed to cwd AND the inventory once s1 calls set_scope()
# Per-line ceiling for the Grep scan — a ReDoS bound, since the pattern is model-supplied.
# Read-surface scoping: root containment alone allows .git/config; copies s1's excludes (layering)
#: Agentic-loop reply to a tool the session never granted (never executed)
# Binary / data-URI guard: both survive the extension filter; some gateways reject data URIs
# Some gateways also reject the bare, case-sensitive text `data:image/` alone: a percent-encoded
# SVG payload or no payload at all. The base64 pass above already removes every form it covers.
# Neutralise the MARKER, not just the payload: never restore it; replacement has no \n
#: ~12K-token ceiling so one Read cannot exhaust context; shared by openai/sdk/tool_adapter
# Scope check BEFORE the existence check, so an excluded path is not an existence oracle.
# Scope-check the RESOLVED target: an in-root symlink must not list an excluded file
# Resolved target, not the link path (see _glob).
# No explicit path: one recursive walk, glob (if any) filters it — never a no-op.
# Scope check BEFORE the is_file/is_dir split: no existence oracle; "." is the root, allowed
# Cap the bytes both searched and emitted per line; mark when cut.
# Binary files yield only mojibake; a matched line must not carry a data-URI marker onward
# Search only the bounded prefix so a model-supplied pattern can't blow up on a line.
# Public surface used by backends/llm/openai.py
# Read/Grep results carry file CONTENT and must not be egressed unredacted; Glob returns paths.
